arStrings.szText: We stand on the cusp of victory. All that's left is to take the plunge.

Davish and Bryona have reunited in the town of Tarsarak, deep within Kehjistan. They now await my arrival before we press onward. 

I must make haste and join them. The hour grows late, and Astaroth's shadow lengthens.
Find Bryona and Davish in Tarsarak

Davish has departed from our company. Yet our task remains. Bryona and I believe that Elias's long-abandoned palace north of Tarsarak may contain the answers we seek - something that can teach us how to summon Astaroth and purge his blood once and for all. 

The way is treacherous, but I must guide Bryona there to the Outer Gardens.

We must enter the Outer Gardens, where a sealed chamber known as the Abandoned Alcove awaits. 

Whatever truths the Horadrim or Elias sought to bury there, we must unearth.
